description: This file defines the BranchPruner class, which manages the control flow for pruning branches within the calculation engine of PhpSpreadsheet. It handles parsing and evaluating nested IF conditions, managing store keys, and tracking conditional states during formula calculation.

classes.name: BranchPruner
classes.description: A class responsible for managing branch pruning logic during formula evaluation, especially handling nested IF statements and conditional execution within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BranchPruner with branch pruning enabled or disabled.

methods.name: clearBranchStore
methods.description: Resets the branch store key counter.

methods.name: initialiseForLoop
methods.description: Prepares internal states for a new loop, resetting conditions and store keys.

methods.name: decrementDepth
methods.description: Decreases the brace depth for the current store key.

methods.name: incrementDepth
methods.description: Increases the brace depth for the current store key.

methods.name: functionCall
methods.description: Handles the invocation of functions, particularly managing the start of new IF blocks.

methods.name: argumentSeparator
methods.description: Handles argument separation within functions, switching branch states after each argument.

methods.name: closingBrace
methods.description: Handles closing of braces, cleaning up after IF blocks are completed.

methods.name: currentCondition
methods.description: Returns the current condition store key, if any.

methods.name: currentOnlyIf
methods.description: Returns the current 'only if' store key, if any.

methods.name: currentOnlyIfNot
methods.description: Returns the current 'only if not' store key, if any.
